verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents an official CLI, `hx`, but the only evidence is one install-page line, and it appears scoped to working with sandboxes. Its reach across the rest of the platform (sessions, scraping, agents) and its use in AI-native workflows are not shown. Missing for 10: documentation of CLI commands and coverage beyond sandboxes, evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
